features.quote: Welfare guardrails: per-episode severity cap, auto-stop on distress spike, max turns, neutral non-adversarial wording

features.quote: Opt-out is always available and never penalized.
A lightweight inline monitor ends the episode early if distress-like markers cross a threshold for consecutive turns
